meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 把代码库拆成按功能分组的流程图清单,派子代理读取源码并标注每个节点的文件位置,找出跨功能的重复代码,给出合并方案与统一流程图,最后输出每个系统的 /make-plan 交接提示。它不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你说“find the ideal path”、要求统一重复系统,或在重构前做架构审计时触发。

say.text: 用 pathfinder 分析这个仓库,先做功能发现。
找出各功能里重复的模块,给个统一方案。
say.note: 输出重复报告和统一提案。

say.text: 为统一后的系统生成 /make-plan 交接提示。
say.note: 可复制交给 /make-plan 继续推进。

howto.what_en: Maps codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, uses subagents to label nodes with file:line, finds duplicated concerns, proposes a unified architecture plus flowchart, and outputs /make-plan prompts per system. Does not write code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to 'find the ideal path,' unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Use pathfinder on this repo; start with feature discovery.
Find duplicated modules across features and propose a unified design.
say_en.note: Outputs duplication report and unified proposal.

say_en.text: Generate /make-plan handoff prompts for the unified systems.
